acreline.summary: Acreline is a WordPress real estate theme for listings, agents, and showing requests. A built-in setup wizard walks identity, colors, and optional demo content after you activate. Twenty-one Core Gutenberg blocks build the marketing pages. Searchable listings, map views, and Customizer identity with eight color styles ship ready — no Elementor or ACF required.
acreline.challenge: Real estate offices need listing filters, a map, and agent pages that match their inventory. Generic luxury realtor skins bury parcels and force IDX chrome offices do not need.

Marketing pages are real Gutenberg blocks with ServerSideRender previews — agencies edit them in the block editor without a developer. Listings, agents, and bookings stay as post types with classic metaboxes so brokers manage their own inventory. Identity and colors also live in the Customizer. Tools → Block Generator and Migrate to Blocks ship in the theme so agencies can build pages without writing PHP.
acreline.result: A ThemeForest-ready pack: install the zip, finish the setup wizard, brand it under Customize → Identity, and sell listings the way buyers search for them.

faq: Is Acreline a real estate theme?
Yes. Acreline is a WordPress real estate theme for offices that need listings, a map, agents, and showing requests — without a suburban MLS skin or Elementor stack.
Does Acreline include a setup wizard?
Yes. After you activate the theme, Appearance → Acreline Setup walks identity, color style, and optional demo content. You can skip it and use Customize anytime.
What do I get when I buy Acreline?

The marketplace pack: acreline.zip (upload in Appearance → Themes), optional child theme, Acreline Core plugin, and HTML documentation. Instant download after checkout. The theme includes the setup wizard. Hire me if you want branded installation or inventory import.
Is Acreline a live MLS or IDX theme?

No. It ships with demo inventory you manage in WordPress. Listings are a custom post type agencies edit in wp-admin. Wire a real MLS/IDX feed later — the UI does not depend on IDX chrome and the post type survives a theme switch via Acreline Core.
How does a real estate agency edit page copy?

Marketing pages use Core Gutenberg blocks with live ServerSideRender previews — your agents edit them directly in wp-admin. Listings, agents, and bookings use classic metaboxes. Brand, phone, and colors stay in Customize → Identity (or the setup wizard). No developer needed for day-to-day edits.
Can I white-label Acreline for a client real estate agency?

Yes. Theme code is GPLv2 or later. Sage / Acorn remain MIT (GPL-compatible). You can install it for a client agency, customize it, resell services on top, or fork it as a white-label base. The child theme is included for safe agency customization.
Do I need Elementor or ACF for Acreline?

No. Marketing pages use the included Gutenberg blocks. Listings and agents use metaboxes. Identity lives in the Customizer and the setup wizard. Do not install a page builder — it adds no value and conflicts with the block architecture.
Can you install or customize Acreline for my real estate office?

Yes. Buy the pack for self-serve, or Get help and I brand it, import your listings, and hand off wp-admin editing to your brokers. I can also wire a real MLS feed or build custom listing filters for your market.

walkridge.blurb: WordPress tour theme for licensed guides — bookable WooCommerce tours, guide bios, area pages, and Customizer identity. No page builder.

Visitors browse tours, meet guides, explore the area, and book directly from the WooCommerce shop — without a page builder. Ten Gutenberg blocks build the marketing pages. Brand, phone, hours, and the header CTA all live in Customize → Identity so operators never touch code.
walkridge.challenge: Tour operators need a site that shows schedules, guide bios, and an area guide alongside a checkout — not a generic booking widget bolted onto a generic theme. Most options are either a bare WooCommerce store with no personality or a full travel agency stack with IDX-level bloat.
walkridge.approach: Marketing pages are dynamic Gutenberg blocks with editor previews — operators build and edit them in wp-admin without a developer. WooCommerce handles the bookable tour products, cart, and checkout. Customizer Identity controls every office-specific detail so the site is fully brandable without touching a template file. Optional companion plugins (Walkridge Bookings, Walkridge Field Map) extend the experience and are sold separately.

tocflow.title: TOCflow
tocflow.blurb: Free WordPress TOC block — accessible, SEO-friendly outline from your headings. Zero config.
tocflow.summary: TOCflow is a lightweight WordPress plugin that builds an accessible, SEO-friendly table of contents from your post headings. Free download for publishers who want a clean TOC without heavy JavaScript.
tocflow.challenge: Long posts need a jump list. Most TOC plugins ship a block library, client-only rendering, or settings you never touch — and the outline misses the first HTML response search engines and screen readers need.
tocflow.approach: One Gutenberg block (plus a shortcode). The outline is server-rendered. Anchors match heading ids. Collapse, sticky, and scroll-spy stay small and optional.
tocflow.result: Insert the block, publish, done. Free on this site and GitHub — a top-of-funnel plugin that shows how I ship focused WordPress tools.
tocflow.audience: Bloggers, docs sites, agencies, and developers who want a TOC without a bloated block pack. Also a free lead-in to hiring me for custom blocks or theme work.
tocflow.architecture: PHP block render callback, small editor script, optional ItemList JSON-LD. No React runtime on the front end for the list itself.
tocflow.handoff: Download the zip, activate, insert Table of Contents. Settings live under Settings → TOCflow. Source on GitHub if you want to fork it.
benefits: Zero config — insert the block; the outline builds itself
Server-rendered HTML for SEO and screen readers
Accurate anchors with aria-current while you read
Numbered or bulleted lists, five style presets
Shortcode for classic content
Free forever — GPLv2 or later
faq: Is TOCflow really free?
Yes. $0 checkout captures your email for update notices if you want them, or download from GitHub Releases. No freemium lock.
Does it work with classic editor posts?
Yes — use the [tocflow] shortcode. Heading anchors still inject on the front end.
Will it slow my site?
The list is in the first HTML response. Front-end JS is optional for sticky/scroll-spy and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Can you customize it for my theme?
Yes. Get help for sticky-header offsets, style presets that match your brand, or a private fork.
tocflow.brand_tagline: One block. An accessible outline from your headings.
